outputs.notes: Migration file: 0027_sticky_swarm.sql. The scores table was created with composite (learnerId, householdId) FK → learners, (subjectId, householdId) FK → subjects, (lessonTaskId, householdId) FK → lesson_tasks. No attempts table. subjects table now has gradingScaleId, aggregationRuleId, isFormalCourse, creditHours, termModel columns. learners/subjects/lesson_tasks each gained a composite UNIQUE(id, household_id). The SQL was reordered to place UNIQUE constraint additions before FK additions — drizzle-kit generated them in FK-first order which would fail in Postgres (FK must reference a PK or UNIQUE that already exists).

outputs.notes: Migration file: 0028_slim_emma_frost.sql. Five tables added to db/schema.ts after the scores block: complianceRulesets (no householdId — platform-wide), householdComplianceConfig (householdId PK → households.id, activeRulesetId → complianceRulesets.id), complianceOverrides, complianceDeadlines, complianceSubmissions. The three household+schoolYear tables use composite (schoolYearId, householdId) FKs → schoolYears(id, household_id), which gained a composite UNIQUE(id, household_id) via the same migration. Migration SQL was reordered (same fix as phase 2): the schoolYears UNIQUE ALTER TABLE statement was moved BEFORE the FK constraint statements that reference it (drizzle-kit generates FK-first, but Postgres requires the referenced UNIQUE to exist first). Phase 5 depends on all five compliance tables existing.
